text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7. Personal Statement Personal Statement with the applicant's signature, written in Chinese or in English. You can download a template or sample from here. 8. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 9. Resume Written in Chinese or in English
